Entries.Name: Kweebec Councilor
Entries.Line: Are you the one prophesized by the Great Old--?

Entries.Name: Kweebec Councilor
Entries.Line: No, you are too squishy even for a human. Where is that metal bark that your kind adores?

Entries.Name: Kweebec Councilor
Entries.Line: You know, because you leathery folk can't grow your own.
